about: The class of the airspace at a field's surface (the engine's surface_airspace), for the airport card's Airspace fact, held by the engine (engine/facade/tests/surface_airspace.rs) and the web (features/plan/components/place/factWords.test.ts). B, C, D or E where a volume of that class reaches the ground, the most restrictive where they overlap (14 CFR 71.41, 71.51, 71.61, 71.71(b)), G where none does (AIM 3-3-1); a shelf over the field is not its class; part-time by NASR's WKHR_CODE, with the class at other times (AIM 3-2-5a1). The volumes as the planner sends NASR's Class Airspace.

cases.about: KORD, Chicago O'Hare: the Class B surface area, its shelves over it
A field under a Class B shelf and a 700 ft Class E: G at its surface
A part-time Class D over a full-time Class E surface area: other times E
A part-time Class D alone: other times G
A part-time Class D and a part-time Class E surface area: E or G other times
A full-time Class E surface area
